subject: Maths
title: Using and writing simple formulae
subtitle: Algebra — Simple Formulae and Sequences · KS3 Maths
learning_objective: I can write and use simple algebraic formulae to solve problems.

key_vocab.definition: A formula is a mathematical rule written with letters and numbers that shows the relationship between quantities.

sections.title: Learning Objective
sections.content: I can write and use simple algebraic formulae to solve problems.

sections.title: Key Words
sections.content: formula -- A formula is a mathematical rule written with letters and numbers that shows the relationship between quantities.

sections.title: Method
sections.content:
Identify the variables, write the rule using letters, then substitute values to evaluate.
C = 5n + 10
5 per item plus 10 fixed cost

Key examples:
  ✓ P = 2l + 2w  (perimeter of a rectangle)
  ✓ A = l × w  (area of a rectangle)
  ✓ C = 5n + 10  (cost formula)
  ✗ P = l + w  (missing the 2s)
  ✗ A = 2(l + w)  (that is perimeter, not area)

sections.title: Worked Example
sections.content:
Example 1 – using a formula
  Use P = 2l + 2w to find the perimeter when l = 8 and w = 5.
  Substitute: P = 2 × 8 + 2 × 5
  Calculate: P = 16 + 10
  P = 26
  P = 26 cm
  (Replace each letter with its value, then follow BIDMAS.)

Example 2 – writing a formula
  A taxi charges £3 fixed plus £2 per mile. Write a formula for cost C for m miles.
  Fixed charge = 3
  Cost per mile = 2m
  Combine: C = 2m + 3
  C = 2m + 3
  (Identify the fixed part and the variable part.)

sections.title: Substituting into formulae
sections.content:
Use P = 2l + 2w. Find P for each pair of values.

(a) l = 6, w = 4
(b) l = 10, w = 3
(c) l = 7, w = 7
(d) l = 12, w = 5

sections.title: Cost formulae
sections.content:
A plumber charges C = 30 + 20h pounds for h hours. Find C.

(a) h = 2
(b) h = 5
(c) h = 0.5
(d) h = 8

sections.title: Writing formulae
sections.content:
Write a formula for each situation.

(a) n books at £4 each, total cost T
(b) p pencils at 30p each plus 50p bag, total C
(c) Perimeter of equilateral triangle side s
(d) Weekly pay: £200 plus £15 per overtime hour h

sections.title: Word problems
sections.content:
Write and use a formula to answer each question.

(a) Gym costs £25/month + £5 joining fee. Cost for m months?
(b) Using your formula, find cost for 6 months.
(c) Rectangle: l = 9, w = 4. Find area using A = lw.
(d) Triangle: b = 12, h = 8. Find A = &frac{1}{2}bh.

sections.title: Mixed formulae
sections.content:
Evaluate each formula.

(a) v = u + at; u = 5, a = 3, t = 4
(b) A = πr²; r = 3 (use π = 3.14)
(c) S = &frac{d}{t}; d = 120, t = 4
(d) y = 3x² − 2; x = 4
(e) V = lwh; l = 5, w = 3, h = 2

sections.title: Common Mistakes
sections.content:
✓ In C = 5n + 10, C means the cost
✗ 2l means 2 + l
✓ P = 2l + 2w gives the perimeter of a rectangle
✗ A = lw gives the perimeter
✓ Substitution means replacing letters with numbers
